easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Faceless Butcher, and Lagrella must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Lagrella for its mana cost.
When Lagrella enters, it exiles Faceless Butcher until Lagrella leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Lagrella's ETB.
When Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Lagrella until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Lagrella leaves the battlefield, Faceless Butcher is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Faceless Butcher enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Faceless Butcher leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Faceless Butcher's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Lagrella is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
